headline: Minus-3 in Buffalo, with Walker out and Johnson carrying

sectionTitles.lastGame: What the 34-7 Arizona box actually showed
sectionTitles.currentState: Short week, Walker out, seed on the line
sectionTitles.gamePlan: How Kansas City should play Buffalo

dek: Kansas City is 8-2 and visits Buffalo on Thu Nov 26, 7:20 PM CT on NBC as a DraftKings three-point underdog on a 45.5 total, with ESPN FPI at 47.1 percent and Kenneth Walker ruled out.
videoHook: Buffalo is laying three on a 45.5 total, Walker is out, and the assignment on Thu Nov 26, 7:20 PM CT is Emmett Johnson plus a cleaner Mahomes plan.
theEdge: ESPN FPI has Kansas City at 47.1 percent in Buffalo against 52.6 for the Bills, DraftKings lists Buffalo minus 3 on a 45.5 total, and the Arizona box traveling with them is 118 rushing yards, 317 net passing yards, 7-of-13 on third down, and zero giveaways.
editorNotes: Markets used: ESPN FPI 47.1/52.6 and DraftKings BUF -3, O/U 45.5. Mahomes line stated as 27-of-39, 324 yards, three touchdowns, one sack. Eight-yard scoring row left undescribed because it is not in the play-by-play excerpt. Karlaftis forced the fumble; J. Fryar recovered for Arizona. Team rush 118 and net pass 317 are the Arizona box, not Atlanta.

storyline.lede: The live story is Buffalo, not the Arizona final. Kansas City is 8-2, the Bills are 9-1, and Thu Nov 26, 7:20 PM CT on NBC is a three-point road ask with a 45.5 total and ESPN FPI giving Kansas City 47.1 percent against 52.6 for Buffalo.
body: Arrowhead Addict has the Chiefs at the AFC's No. 5 seed entering a three-game road stretch that starts in Buffalo and continues at the Rams on Thu Dec 3, 7:15 PM CT. Andy Reid and Eric Bieniemy do not get a normal week to install, and Kenneth Walker is ruled out, so the run plan is Emmett Johnson's.

The Arizona tape that should travel is specific: 435 yards, 27 first downs, 7-of-13 on third down, 32:26 of possession across 10 drives, and zero giveaways. Patrick Mahomes was 27-of-39 for 324 yards and three touchdowns, with one sack and five quarterback hits. That is the efficiency to protect, not a blank slate.
Buffalo gets Josh Allen in his own building as a favorite. Credit the opponent. The edge is situational, not assumed.

lastGameReview.label: Week 11 · Sun, Nov 22 · 12:00 PM CT
lastGameReview.lede: Kansas City beat Arizona 34-7 with four touchdowns to one, two field goals, 435 yards, and zero turnovers. Mahomes was 27-of-39 for 324 yards and three touchdowns.

analysis.body: The box was control, not a track meet. Kansas City had 27 first downs, 31 rushes for 118 yards, 317 net passing yards, 32:26 of possession, and 10 drives. Arizona had 14 first downs, 21 rushes for 75 yards, 130 net passing yards, 27:34, and nine drives, going 5-of-13 on third down.

takeaways.title: Johnson was the run game
takeaways.body: Emmett Johnson had 23 carries for 105 yards and a touchdown, plus four catches, 27 touches. His 3-yard score up the middle at Q1 0:48 made it 14-0.

takeaways.title: Pressure without a takeaway
takeaways.body: Karlaftis forced a fumble on a sack at Q3 10:30. J. Fryar recovered for Arizona. Both teams finished with zero turnovers.

whatWorked: Third down at 7-of-13 and a 34-7 final with no giveaways
whatDidnt: Team rush stayed at 118 yards on 31 attempts
One sack and five quarterback hits on Mahomes, plus intentional grounding at Q2 0:16

currentState.lede: Kansas City is 8-2 and a road underdog on a short week, with Walker out and the No. 5 seed in front of a Buffalo-Rams-Cincinnati stretch.

workOn.title: Finish the run without Walker
workOn.body: Johnson's 105 yards carried the Arizona ground game inside a 118-yard team total. Bieniemy has to keep early downs on schedule with Jaydn Ott and Nate Carter as changeups, not as a replacement feature.

workOn.title: Keep Mahomes off the ground
workOn.body: One sack and five hits is manageable. A Thursday road start against Josh Allen does not need another grounding or a stalled red-zone series like the two Kansas City field goals of 40 and 44.

workOn.title: Hold the third-down gain
workOn.body: Arizona was 7-of-13 after Atlanta was 4-of-13. That gain has to show up again, because Buffalo can live on long fields if Kansas City starts stacking third-and-medium.

thinkAbout.title: How much is Johnson's game now
thinkAbout.body: Arrowhead Addict has him in the top four of Offensive Rookie of the Year odds. Walker being out makes the touches a plan, not a cameo. Reid still has to decide how many of the 27 from Arizona he wants repeated.

thinkAbout.title: Seed math versus the price
thinkAbout.body: A 9-1 home favorite at minus 3 is a real problem. Winning moves the No. 5 conversation. Losing on a 45.5 total still leaves a Rams trip four days later.

gamePlan.lede: Beat a 9-1 Buffalo team on Thu Nov 26, 7:20 PM CT at NBC as a three-point underdog, with Walker out and FPI still leaning Bills at 52.6 percent.
gamePlan.howTheyMatch: Kansas City's recent identity is Mahomes efficiency, Kelce in the middle, and Johnson as the early-down runner. Buffalo's identity, in durable terms, is Josh Allen plus a home favorite's margin. Arrowhead Pride frames this as the league's premier rivalry, 8-2 against 9-1. The leverage is down-and-distance: stay out of third-and-long, and do not give Allen a short field after a sack or a penalty.

keys.title: Johnson on schedule
keys.body: Inside zone and a screen keep Buffalo's front honest. If the 23-carry role shrinks, Mahomes will see more than the five hits he took against Arizona.

keys.title: Defined throws to Kelce, Rice, and Downs
keys.body: Kelce had six catches and two touchdowns. Rashee Rice had six catches. Josh Downs had four in this game and, per Arrowhead Pride, eight catches on 28 snaps across two games with Cyrus Allen also in the rotation. Use the rubs. Do not hunt a hero ball on every snap.

keys.title: Two-deep, then the zone blitz as a call
keys.body: Spagnuolo should take the deep shot away with Cover-2 and use a zone blitz on long downs. That is a call for Buffalo, not a claim about the Arizona sack-fumble, which Fryar recovered.

script: Open with under-center inside zone to Johnson and force a light box before any shot play.
On second-and-medium, mesh Kelce and Rice with Downs as the sit or corner tag and Johnson as the checkdown.
Steal a possession with a screen if the rush shows heat after Mahomes' one sack and five hits last game.
In the red zone, prefer the defined middle throw that became Kelce's 22-yard touchdown over an undefined fade.
After a change of possession, start in Cover-2 so Allen does not get a free vertical on the first snap of a drive.

spotlight.title: A real underdog number
spotlight.body: DraftKings has Buffalo minus 3 on 45.5. ESPN FPI is 47.1 percent for Kansas City and 52.6 for the Bills. That is a lean, not a toss-up costume.

spotlight.title: Walker is out
spotlight.body: Arrowhead Pride's final injury report rules Kenneth Walker out. The Arizona touch chart already had Johnson at 27 touches, Ott at five rushes, and Carter at one.

spotlight.title: Johnson in the OROY mix
spotlight.body: Arrowhead Addict has Emmett Johnson in the top four of Offensive Rookie of the Year odds after a 23-carry, 105-yard, one-touchdown line.

spotlight.title: Downs and Allen are in the plan
spotlight.body: Arrowhead Pride notes Downs has eight catches on 28 snaps in two games, with Cyrus Allen also boosting the room. Allen's 26-yard catch to the Arizona 18 is on the tape.

spotlight.title: No. 5, then three road games
spotlight.body: Arrowhead Addict has Kansas City at the AFC's No. 5 seed. Buffalo is the start of that road stretch, not a standalone showcase.

matchups.unit: Chiefs run game vs. Bills front
matchups.chiefs: Emmett Johnson, 23 carries, 105 yards, one touchdown; team rush 118 on 31
matchups.opponent: Buffalo front, home favorite, Walker ruled out for Kansas City
matchups.note: Johnson can carry early downs. The team total was still 118, so this is not a finished rushing identity against a 9-1 front.

matchups.chiefs: Patrick Mahomes, 27-of-39, 324 yards, three touchdowns, one sack, five hits
matchups.opponent: Buffalo secondary in a minus-3 home spot
matchups.note: The Arizona rating was 120.0. Buffalo is the better opponent, and the five hits are the caution.

matchups.unit: Kelce and the new receivers vs. Bills linebackers
matchups.chiefs: Travis Kelce 6 for 74 and two touchdowns; Rice 6 catches; Downs 4 catches
matchups.note: Defined crossers and the middle shot are the clearest Kansas City advantage on this sheet.

matchups.chiefs: Eight quarterback hits, Karlaftis 2.5 sacks, Josh Johnson sacked three times
matchups.note: The Arizona pressure tape is real. Allen at home is still the harder quarterback problem, which is why FPI sits at 52.6 percent.

matchups.opponent: Bills offense that can flip a short field
matchups.note: The conversion gain matters only if it survives a short week. Arizona's 5-of-13 is not Buffalo's line.

xsandos.title: Johnson inside zone on first down
xsandos.situation: 1st-and-10 at Buffalo, Walker out, early in the Thu Nov 26, 7:20 PM CT game
xsandos.why: Johnson just handled 23 carries for 105 yards, including repeated up-the-middle runs, and the team needs more than a 118-yard rushing day against a favorite.
xsandos.coaching: Bieniemy: zone steps, one cut, and do not bounce it into a rally. Ott and Carter are the changeup, not the identity.

xsandos.title: Mesh to Kelce and Rice
xsandos.situation: 2nd-and-6 to 2nd-and-8 versus man, Buffalo pinning outside
xsandos.why: Kelce's 22-yard touchdown was a deep middle throw, and he and Rice each had six catches. Downs gives Bieniemy a third option on the sit.
xsandos.coaching: Reid: rub the crossers, let Kelce sit if the linebacker chases Rice, and throw on time so the five-hit tape does not grow.

xsandos.title: Johnson screen against heat
xsandos.situation: 2nd-and-long after a crowded rush look, Mahomes coming off one sack and five hits
xsandos.why: Johnson already caught four balls in the 27-touch day. A screen is an easy answer if Buffalo sells out up the field on a short week.
xsandos.coaching: Bieniemy: let the line lead, throw the screen before the hit, and have Gray or Downs occupy the nearest overhang.

xsandos.title: Four verts if Buffalo shows a single-high shell
xsandos.situation: 2nd-and-short or after a Johnson gain, Kansas City in plus territory
xsandos.why: Worthy and Allen are the vertical tags, Downs and Rice can bend the seams, and Mahomes just threw three touchdowns without a giveaway.
xsandos.coaching: If the safety stays middle, bend the seams to the hash. If Buffalo rotates late, take Allen's 26-yard-type space rather than forcing Worthy through a bracket.

xsandos.title: Cover-2 after a change of possession
xsandos.situation: Bills first down after a Kansas City score or a punt, Allen in the gun
xsandos.why: Two deep and five under takes the free shot away from a home favorite. Arizona managed 130 net passing yards; Buffalo will not be that limited unless the shell is disciplined.
xsandos.coaching: Spagnuolo: safeties stay on top, Nick Bolton and the hooks rally, and Chris Jones wins the interior without the secondary leaving early.

xsandos.title: Zone blitz on a Buffalo long down
xsandos.situation: 2nd-and-long or 3rd-and-long, Bills needing a chunk, not a claimed takeaway look
xsandos.why: Use it as a call: show heat, drop a lineman, and rush a second-level player so Allen has to throw hot into zone. Do not treat Karlaftis' Arizona sack as proof this call already produced a takeaway. Fryar recovered that fumble.
xsandos.coaching: Spagnuolo: Karlaftis can be the rusher or the dropper depending on the presentation. Bolton fires only if the coverage replaces him. No gap call beyond what the picture shows.

coaching.topic: Reid and Bieniemy on a short week
coaching.detail: The install has to be Johnson, mesh, and a screen, not a new 30-play packet, with the Rams waiting on Thu Dec 3, 7:15 PM CT.
Start in Cover-2 and spend the zone blitz on long downs. The Arizona pressure numbers do not automatically travel to a 9-1 quarterback.

injuries.note: Ruled out on the final Week 12 injury report for Buffalo.

personnel.detail: With Walker out, the Arizona line of 23 carries, 105 yards, four catches, and 27 touches is the baseline, with Ott and Carter behind him.

personnel.move: Downs and Allen in the receiver rotation
personnel.detail: Arrowhead Pride reports Downs has eight catches on 28 snaps in two games, with Cyrus Allen also providing a boost. Both were targeted in the Arizona game.

strategies: Lean on Johnson for early-down inside zone so Mahomes is not in third-and-long after one sack and five hits.
Build the passing menu around Kelce, Rice, and Downs, with Allen and Worthy as the vertical alerts.
Use a screen as the pressure answer rather than asking Mahomes to hold the ball.
Open defensive series in Cover-2 and save the zone blitz for Buffalo long downs.
Treat field position as the 45.5-total problem: zero giveaways traveled from Arizona, and that has to travel again.
debates: Is minus 3 the right price for an 8-2 team with Walker out?
Should Johnson see another 23-carry day, or does a short week require more Ott and Carter?
Is the No. 5 seed a warning, or just the cost of the Buffalo-Rams road pair?
Does Spagnuolo sit in Cover-2 longer than Kansas City fans want against Allen?
